main_conclusion: Fixed entry-close stops, held-close trailing peaks, route locking, disabled regime exits, confirmation relief, entry-refresh memory and price-cycle simplification already have substantial coverage. Do not propose them as fresh mechanisms. A market-episode clock independent of accepted trades is the clearest as-yet-unverified expression difference, but has strong opportunity-loss counterevidence. A profit-activated one-way protection latch is not found in the reviewed source; actual filled-cost breakeven cannot be claimed from these history-only native adapters.

remaining_expression_differences.difference: Advance an opportunity-episode observer continuously from complete T market history regardless of actual holding, confirmation acceptance, failed buys or TIME exit. The observer owns its opportunity origin and reset; accepted entry/exit only changes transaction state. This contrasts with the parent whose age/anchor/category is established or cleared by each accepted signal, EX034/035 pending set only after an actual policy TIME exit, and EX077 market state becoming HELD when its buy event occurs.
remaining_expression_differences.possible_minimal_design_not_yet_frozen: Use a single original causal eligibility crossing to open an episode and the reverse crossing to reset it, with explicit initial/warmup boundary. Persist episode origin while raw regime switches or score rejects; use transaction0/1 actions without resetting observer at accepted trade. Root must first freeze whether one admission per episode or repeated eligible admissions are allowed, and what exit remains independent. No new market threshold, calendar wait or future-year label.
remaining_expression_differences.why_might_reduce_avalanche: Different accepted entry dates need not immediately create different observer episode clocks, so a TIME exit alone does not reset the opportunity identity. This is a path-geometry hypothesis, not evidence of reduced financial losses or guaranteed resynchronization.
remaining_expression_differences.strongest_counter: EX034/035 already show episode-refresh restrictions can remove good repeat entries and break down-year profitability. EX077 independent-looking price-cycle simplification fails return and frequency. Different eligibility/range/regime parameters can still produce different episode boundaries, so this does not eliminate parameter sensitivity.
remaining_expression_differences.minimum_before_account: One factorized observer/transaction specification, synthetic same-market/different-acceptance histories proving observer independence; matched disabled-observer equivalence with the exact parent; full numeric domain including every effective new coordinate; then at most one predeclared center without adapting to observed-year profits. Old aggregate frequency failures are historical facts, not automatic qualification under the new positive-year frequency gate.
remaining_expression_differences.native_expressibility: Pure inputs/sessions history state machine producing target0/1 is expressible in reviewed native adapters. Actual-fill-based observer resets are not supplied by those adapters.

remaining_expression_differences.difference: An accepted signal episode begins with no new floor protection; only after a causally known favorable excursion activates a latch does a subsequent return toward a fixed signal-entry reference trigger0. The latch is monotone within that episode and is not cleared merely by rawregime flips. This differs from always-on EX025/026 anchor-loss and from ordinary continuously updated percentage peak trailing.
remaining_expression_differences.not_yet_scientifically_selected: No activation threshold, floor or route scope has been approved/frozen. There is no basis here for threshold search, arbitrary2-fee activation, pretending the1%limit premium equals actual cost, or automatically combining this latch with changed regime exits.
remaining_expression_differences.strongest_counter: EX025/026 cut rebounds and caused2023 losses. Ordinary trailing and EX077 locked price retrace already failed. A new latch introduces another discontinuous activation surface and can increase churn; lower state count or prettier drawdown cannot establish four-gate32 success.
remaining_expression_differences.minimum_before_account: One matched latch-on/latch-off policy with same entries, timers, priorities and regime behavior; predeclare activation/floor business meaning and full active parameter geometry. First validate monotone latch, ties, crossregime persistence, top-up/retry semantics and T+1 delay using synthetic inputs. Signal floor only; every actual result must come from a full native account.
remaining_expression_differences.native_expressibility: Signal-entry-reference latch with history-only state and0/1 target is expressible. A latch using actual weighted filled cost/fees is not established by reviewed adapter contracts.
